description: KISA infra+web vulnerability scan on Windows; uploads CSV to S3 results/. Reuses kisa_all_check.ps1 from S3 tools/ (fetched via instance role).

S3Base.description: S3 base prefix (tools/ and results/ live under it).

runCommand: if (-not (Get-Command aws -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host '[*] installing aws cli...'; Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList '/i https://awscli.amazonaws.com/AWSCLIV2.msi /qn' -Wait; $env:Path += ';C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2' }
if (-not (Get-Command aws -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host '[!] aws CLI not available'; exit 1 }
if (-not (Get-ChildItem "$work\scan\*.csv" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host '[!] no CSV produced'; exit 1 }
